sentences.text: The current UCB directions cover loans and advances sanctioned or renewed on or after 1 January 2026, and I cannot confirm applicability here because the sanction date is not in the provided record.

For a Tier 3 UCB, the no-pre-payment-charge rule for loans granted for business purpose to MSEs applies only to sanctioned amount or limit up to ₹50 lakh, so that specific prohibition does not cover an ₹80 lakh loan.

For cases outside those specific rules, pre-payment charges, if any, are to be as per the approved policy of a UCB, and the applicability or otherwise of pre-payment charges must be clearly disclosed in the sanction letter and loan agreement.
On the provided record alone, I cannot determine whether the 2% charge is a violation because the bank’s approved policy is not provided.

missing.searched: Looked for the loan sanction date or renewal date needed to test the 1 January 2026 applicability in the current UCB directions.
Looked for the bank’s approved pre-payment-charge policy needed to assess whether a 2% charge is allowed for a loan outside the specific Tier 3 up-to-₹50 lakh rule.
